Basque

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Spanish absurdo (“absurd, absurdity”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /abs̺urdo/ [aβ̞.s̺ur.ð̞o]
  • Rhymes: -urdo, -o
  • Hyphenation: ab‧sur‧do

Adjective

[edit]

absurdo (comparative absurdoago, superlative absurdoen, excessive absurdoegi)

  1. absurd
    Synonym: zentzugabe

absurdo inan

Galician

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin absurdus.

Adjective

[edit]

absurdo (feminine absurda, masculine plural absurdos, feminine plural absurdas)

  1. absurd

Derived terms

[edit]
  • absurdamente
  • absurdeza

Related terms

[edit]
  • xordo

Noun

[edit]

absurdo m (plural absurdos)

  1. absurdity (an absurd action)
    Synonym: absurdeza

Further reading

[edit]
  • “absurdo”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026

Hiligaynon

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish absurdo.

Noun

[edit]

absúrdo

  1. absurdity, nonsense

Latin

[edit]

Adjective

[edit]

absurdō

  1. dative/ablative masculine/neuter singular of absurdus

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin absurdus.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /abˈsuʁ.du/ [abˈsuɦ.du], /a.biˈsuʁ.du/ [a.biˈsuɦ.du]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /abˈsuʁ.du/ [abˈsuɦ.du], /a.biˈsuʁ.du/ [a.biˈsuɦ.du]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /abˈsuɾ.du/, /a.biˈsuɾ.du/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /abˈsuʁ.du/, /a.biˈsuʁ.du/
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /abˈsuɻ.du/, /a.biˈsuɻ.du/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /abˈsuʁ.do/ [abˈsuɦ.do]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐˈbsuɾ.du/ [ɐˈβsuɾ.ðu]

  • Hyphenation: ab‧sur‧do

Adjective

[edit]

absurdo (feminine absurda, masculine plural absurdos, feminine plural absurdas, comparable, comparative mais absurdo, superlative o mais absurdo or absurdíssimo)

  1. absurd

Quotations

[edit]

For quotations using this term, see Citations:absurdo.

Related terms

[edit]
  • surdo

Noun

[edit]

absurdo m (plural absurdos)

  1. absurdity
  2. nonsense
    Synonyms: see Thesaurus:tolice

Quotations

[edit]

For quotations using this term, see Citations:absurdo.

Further reading

[edit]
  • “absurdo”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “absurdo”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin absurdus.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /abˈsuɾdo/ [aβ̞ˈsuɾ.ð̞o]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -uɾdo
  • Syllabification: ab‧sur‧do

Adjective

[edit]

absurdo (feminine absurda, masculine plural absurdos, feminine plural absurdas)

  1. absurd, preposterous, ludicrous, ridiculous

Derived terms

[edit]
  • absurdamente (“absurdly”)

Related terms

[edit]
  • absurdidad (“absurdity”)
  • sordo

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Basque: absurdo
  • → Hiligaynon: absurdo

Noun

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
absurdo
Wikipedia es

absurdo m (plural absurdos)

  1. something that is absurd or ridiculous
    Synonym: absurdidad

Further reading

[edit]
  • “absurdo”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Tagalog

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish absurdo, from Latin absurdus.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ʔabˈsuɾdo/ [ʔɐbˈsuɾ.d̪o]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -uɾdo
  • Syllabification: ab‧sur‧do

Adjective

[edit]

absurdo (Baybayin spelling ᜀᜊ᜔ᜐᜓᜇ᜔ᜇᜓ)

  1. absurd
    Synonym: baligho

Derived terms

[edit]
  • kaabsurduhan

Related terms

[edit]
  • absurdismo
  • absurdista

Further reading

[edit]
  • “absurdo”, in Pambansang Diksiyonaryo | Diksiyonaryo.ph, 2018
  • Cuadrado Muñiz, Adolfo (1972), Hispanismos en el tagalo: diccionario de vocablos de origen español vigentes en esta lengua filipina, Madrid: Oficina de Educación Iberoamericana, page 5
